Priya S.: Quick spend-sentry for Lumenix — hosted API commit vs actual drifted this week, flagged an anomaly. Posting snapshot below, tagging ops for triage.

```Account: Lumenix
Commit: $12,000/month
Period: 2026-03-15 — 2026-03-21
Spent: $16,560 (+38% vs expected projection)
Top drivers: embeddings 71%, completions 21%, misc 8%
Avg latency (p50): 82ms (+12ms)
Error rate: 0.6% (no spike)
Anomaly: embeddings bulk burst — 23,462 embedding units on 2026-03-18 02:15 UTC
Flag ID: spend-sentry-2212345678
``` 

BillingBot: :warning: Alert created: spend-sentry-2212345678. Auto-ticket #CS-4829 opened and assigned to @Priya S. (see /tickets/CS-4829)

Jorge L.: @Priya S. any idea if this came from a new API key or an integration test gone wild? Can you paste the top client_id or call pattern?

Priya S.: digging — top client_id starts with lx-cust-49b, repeated embedding calls with batch_size ~512. snippet below:

```json
{"endpoint":"/v1/embeddings","model":"text-embed-002","client_id":"lx-cust-49b","requests":23462}
```

Maya T.: if embeddings are that batchy we should suggest temporary rate-limit and recommended batch_size cap (128). Also check whether they switched to a cheaper quantized model recently — sometimes that increases throughput unintentionally. :mag:

Samir R.: I'll prep an enablement touchpoint for Lumenix. Priya, can we include cost-optimisation playbook + suggested batching and a brief explanation of how prefix/KV caching could reduce spend?

Priya S.: Yep — I'll reach out to customer with a summary + mitigation steps (rate-limit, lower batch_size to 128, model pin to stable-embed-v1). Will update ticket CS-4829 when contact is made. :white_check_mark:

CS Ops: Logged action items: 1) notify customer (Priya) 2) apply temporary quota if requested 3) run hourly spend diff for 24h to confirm falloff. 

Jorge L.: Also flagged for runtime team — possible client-side retry loop. @eng-runtime FYI :eyes:

Priya S.: thanks all — will update thread after next sync (ETA: 2h).
